prompt: Research one SiC and GaN power-semiconductor adoption investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: Higher AI rack power and 800-900 volt EV, charging, and inverter architectures may drive selective SiC and GaN content, but yield, utilisation, pricing, and balance sheets determine value creation.
inputs.drivers: AI power density; 800 VDC power trees; EV charging; traction platforms; renewable and grid inverters; design wins; 150-to-200mm transitions; packaging; yield; utilisation; Chinese capacity.
inputs.value_chain: Integrated SiC and GaN substrate, epitaxy, device, and module producers; reliability and yield-test equipment; packaging; AI power integrators; data centres; EVs; chargers; inverters; legacy silicon and weak pure-play counterviews.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires qualified suppliers to translate efficiency and power-density benefits into content, utilisation, margin, and multi-quarter revenue visibility.
inputs.invalidation: Silicon closes the gap, architecture adoption slips, capacity outruns demand, qualification delays, Chinese supply compresses prices, yields disappoint, or capital intensity prevents free cash flow.
